title: 건널목 개량촉진법 시행령 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Consultation on Repair of Railroad Crossing Facilities and Entrustment of Duties)
(1) When a railroad crossing manager repairs railroad crossing facilities, if the manager is a railroad facility manager, prior consultation shall be made with the road management authority; if the manager is a road management authority, prior consultation shall be made with the railroad facility manager.
(2) Where a railroad crossing manager is a road management authority, the manager may entrust to the railroad facility manager duties concerning maintenance, repair, and management of railroad crossing facilities. In such cases, where the railroad facility manager repairs railroad crossing facilities, the manager shall notify the relevant road management authority in advance.
